bodyHtml:
What This Is

AI agents that autonomously initiate, route, optimise and settle payments on behalf of users—Amazon 'Buy for Me' is the first commercial signal..

Laboratory or proof-of-concept demonstrations successful. Commercial path is not yet clear. Our research database tracks 2 independent sources on this technology.

Amazon 'Buy for Me' (beta): AI agents complete purchases on third-party sites autonomously. 57% of business leaders expect agentic commerce mainstream within 3 years. PayPal stablecoin + OpenAI partnership. Accenture 2026.

Status

Attribute Value
Development Stage Proof of Concept
Confidence Level Researching
Confidence Score +0.60
Estimated Deployment 2026–2030
Horizon Near-Term (2027–2028)
Independent Sources Tracked 2

Prerequisites

This technology depends on or is closely linked to:

  • Mastercard AI Payment Intent Cryptogram
  • Programmable Money

What This Enables

Advancement here directly benefits or unblocks:

  • Agentic Commerce

Investment Exposure

No direct listed-stock exposure identified yet in our research database.
